name: @pipeworx/mcp-nass

tools.name: nass_query
tools.description: Search USDA agricultural statistics by commodity, statistic, geography, and year. Returns production, yield, acreage, prices, and livestock data (e.g., commodity="CORN", state_fips="06" for California).

stat_category.description: Statistic category, e.g., "YIELD", "PRODUCTION", "AREA PLANTED", "AREA HARVESTED", "PRICE RECEIVED", "INVENTORY"

source.description: Data source: "SURVEY" or "CENSUS" (optional, defaults to all)

group.description: Commodity group, e.g., "FIELD CROPS", "FRUIT & TREE NUTS", "VEGETABLES" (optional)

tools.name: nass_crop_production
tools.description: Get US crop yields, production totals, and planted/harvested acreage by crop, state, and year. Quick access to major crop survey data.

state.description: State name, e.g., "IOWA" (optional, defaults to national)

tools.name: nass_prices
tools.description: Get prices received by US farmers for crops and livestock by commodity, state, and year. Track agricultural commodity price trends and market movements.

tools.name: nass_livestock
tools.description: Get US livestock inventory, slaughter counts, and production data by species, state, and time period. Analyze animal agriculture supply and production.

tools.name: nass_crop_progress
tools.description: Weekly USDA crop progress + condition by crop and state. For CONDITION queries ("what % of corn is good or excellent", "crop condition this week") the response includes a condition_summary with the latest national week's ratings AND the standard combined good_or_excellent_pct. For PROGRESS use stat_category="PROGRESS" (planted/emerged/harvested %). Pass stat_category to narrow (otherwise both are returned).

year.description: Year, e.g., "2026". Optional — defaults to current year.

stat_category.description: Narrow to "CONDITION" (good/excellent ratings) or "PROGRESS" (planting/harvest %). Optional — omit for both.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-nass forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the nass pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
